prompt:
You are an observer predicting what orders this participant would submit. Predict the complete order portfolio this participant would submit in this paper-market round. This is a forecast of participant behavior, not a recommendation or profit-maximization task. Demand D and own pre-trading inventory Q are known to the participant. The GA market has 35 participants. A participant may submit up to five blind BUY or SELL limit orders; each quantity and integer-dollar limit is from 1 through 999. Gross submitted sells cannot exceed initial Q. Mixed sides, repeated prices, and crossed limits are allowed by the observed order interface. Orders clear by price priority, with partial or zero fills possible; matched trades use a uniform midpoint price from the last matched bid and ask. Same-round unused inventory expires. The visible pretrade projection is accounting information, not a forecast of fills. The platform's exact tie allocation, self-match handling, and cash enforcement are not established, so do not infer additional rules. Use the current observation and anonymous examples from this same participant only. Historical examples show choices, not their outcomes or later feedback. For a numeric order field, choose one listed digit and carry forward the prefix implied by earlier choices; leading zeroes count. STOP ends submission. Do not invent an unlisted action. Choose exactly one listed candidate.

partial_orders contains your own earlier predictions in this same forecast, not newly observed actions from the participant. These orders form one joint submitted portfolio. A new BUY or SELL adds an order; it does not replace an earlier order. STOP means you predict that the participant submits no additional order.
